subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 9: Literacy – Writing an information text
outcomes: Use facts from a fact file to write an information text.
Follow the rules: full sentences, no abbreviations, adjectives, logical order.
Check a partner's text and give helpful feedback.

tf.s: In an information text, we write full sentences.
It is good to use abbreviations like kg and m in an information text.
tf.why: Write the full words: kilograms, metres.

tf.s: Hammerhead shark babies are called pups.
A hammerhead shark can weigh up to 450 kilograms.
tf.why: Yes, it is a very heavy fish.

tf.s: The hammerhead shark's favourite food is seaweed.
Adjectives can make an information text more interesting.
tf.why: Yes, words like strange and amazing help.

tf.s: The hammerhead shark lives in cold rivers.
tf.why: It lives in warm water in oceans around the world.

tf.s: We should order the facts in a logical way.
tf.why: Yes, a clear order helps the reader.

tf.s: An information text should start with the animal's family.
tf.why: Start with the name and type to introduce the animal.

tf.s: We should use all the facts from the fact file.
tf.why: Yes, that is one of the rules.

boxes.q: Pups are a fact for which heading?
How long can a hammerhead shark be?
boxes.why: It can be up to six metres.

boxes.q: Which is a sentence, not a note?
boxes.why: A sentence has a subject and a verb.
cm is the short form of centimetres.

boxes.q: Which is a good fact file heading?
boxes.why: Food is a fact file heading.

boxes.q: Why is it called a hammerhead shark?
o: Its head looks like a hammer.
boxes.why: Its wide head has a hammer shape.

boxes.q: What do we call feedback with two good points and one idea?
boxes.why: Stars are good points; the wish helps next time.

hunt.q: Shark with a head like a tool
A shark is a kind of …

mcq.q: Which is NOT a rule for writing an information text?
o: Put the facts in a logical order.
mcq.why: We avoid abbreviations in an information text.

mcq.q: Under which heading do you write 'stingrays'?
What should come first in an information text?
Which animal does the teacher use as a model fact file?
mcq.why: The model fact file is about the Arabian leopard.

mcq.q: Change the note into a sentence: Home – warm water in oceans.
o: The hammerhead shark lives in warm water in oceans all around the world.
The hammerhead shark home is warm.
mcq.why: A full sentence has a subject and a verb.

mcq.q: Rewrite without abbreviations: up to 6 m long and 450 kg.
o: up to six metres long and it weighs up to 450 kilograms
up to 6 m long and 450 kilograms
up to six minutes long and 450 kg
up to six miles long and 450 grams
mcq.why: Write the full words for m and kg.

mcq.q: Add an adjective: It has a ___ head.
mcq.why: Strange is an adjective that describes the head.

mcq.q: Why shouldn't we use abbreviations in an information text?
o: Because the text uses full sentences and complete words.
Because fact files have no numbers.

mcq.q: Which is the best first sentence for an information text?
o: The Arabian leopard is a rare and beautiful mammal.
mcq.why: It introduces the animal with its name and type.

mcq.q: Which is the most helpful feedback for a partner's text?
o: Your facts are clear. Next time, write the size in full words.
mcq.why: Good feedback gives praise and one clear tip.
